listing.name: CJY's Toy Box
listing.summary: Adds a new faction, a plot-driven story, a roaming merchant fleet, supply allocation mechanics, officer hiring, nanoforge repair, and various new ships and weapons.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a new faction, a plot-driven story, a roaming merchant fleet, supply allocation mechanics, officer hiring, nanoforge repair, and various new ships and weapons.

description:
CJY's Toy Box

Requires Lazylib.

Magic Lib, Graphics Lib, and BoxUtil (Likely require latest 1.5.4 ver of Box Util)
Lunalib adds additional mod function, but only Lazylib is mandatory

After the First AI War, A unknown research fleet tried to research specialized terraforming plant by making use of AI cores as a replacement for the terraforming equipments that has stopped functioning since the collapse. They encountered a destroyed AI ship in a certain unknown system, and their internal disagreement over how to deal with the ship culminated in a deadly decision that caused their AI to summon an automated fleet to destroy the research fleet.

A hundred year has since passed, and a group of clones who claim to be survivors of that lost fleet is now looking to form their own base and faction to protect themselves from exploitation by other faction under the guise of 'aiding' them.

The player would encounter an anxious individual with a damaged blueprint pack, and this start their encounter with The Survivors. (Hang out in bars, each segment of the story is connected by meeting a npc in a bar.)

V0.5.7 update with some bug fix and optimization, save compatible 0.5.6.

The Mod adds a faction that could either appear in regular game or be discovered after a plot line initiated by a bar encounter. It also incorporate a variety of other feature and functions, notably:

Stellar Convenience Store

A roaming merchant fleet that can be found in bars and sell various item to player, as relation improve, their stock will get better. Player can improve relation by doing business with them or donating ships to their fleet.

Supply Allocation

Certain weapon and hullmod in this mod cost special commodities, and a fixed pool of free allocation can be obtained from either befriending the Survivors faction or having necessary industry, after this free pool is used up, resource will be drawn from cargo hold.

Officer Hiring

The survivors officer customized officer hiring process allowing player to hire officers with a variety of different options that can be selected in Lunalib

Nanoforge Repair

After advancing the Survivor's plot, they offer nanoforge repair services

SpoilerThe mod also adds a plot line against certain hidden enemy that will end up in the Survivor building their own stations and supplying certain strategic resource required to power special weapon and systems, as well as a mother ship that can be used to produce various supply, weapon, LPC, and smaller ships on the go.[close]

A new faction, ships, and a series of weapon and hull mods including laser guided missiles, autocannon with armor piercing mechanics, etc

Stuff in Action

Spoiler

[close]

Credit

Author cjy4312

Art:  Shenqiang /Zhizhu (Changle) /cjy4312 /Tifuni

Translated by Mycophobia

Update Logs

Spoiler

Updated to CN Version v0.5.7a

Fixes:

Fixed destroying EM-003 before destroy the Ember base will cause the Ember bounty become uncollectable.

Fixed Issue with normalmap for Mothership

Fixed Certain missing localization for ctb_shop_items

Fixed issue preventing survivors from properly issuing bounties

Fixed an issue causing the covenience store to be permenatly removed if the system Greda was in was removed by other mods

Fixed an issue causing the covenience store to spawn even while the player side with the Hegemony to capture the Covenience Store owner.

Adjustment

Ember blade drone's cooldown before re-launching no longer fixed to 50 seconds, if the drone return due to no enemy located, the launch cooldown will be proportionately reduced

Code Name - Ember's Large Expanded Missile Rack replaced with Missile Autoforge

Adjusted loadorder for Covenience Store Goods

Loading the save in dev mode will remove and re-generate goods in the covenience store

Autocannon series of weapon will use AP shell against fighter with shield arc greater than 50

Owl RGM's custom AI adjusted, in autofire, it will not fire in volley against a single target, there will be a minimal of 0.5sec delay between shots from different instances of the weapon.

Mod Compatiblity

Compatibility with special shield mechanic added by MechExpansionModule (Fossic Mod)

Fixed rule issue and incorrect BP list for survivor market from test release.

Updated to CN version v0.5.6a

NOT SAVE COMPATIBLE WITH EARLIER VERSIONS

Moved all global.memorydata to CTBCampaign data for storage -> This will break old saves.

Includes previous EN April 05 hotfix

Increased size of Mothership's system selection UI

Ship with Energy Core system now have a new UI display.

Covenience Store will log the variant ID before randomly purchasing new ships for the store fleet.

Ember Faction will no longer be named ?? initially to avoid certain string issues.

Mothership sprite's file dimension reworked to work with new UI (does not affect appearance of actual sprite in game)

Given codex change in 0.98, removed common survivors faction ship from sim opponents.

Codex Unlockable tag and Module hint added to the station.

Removed unused station and ship sprite to reduce size of the mod.

Hofix April -05

Added some Randomized Station names for survivor stations

DP cost of Cavalier(HEG)  Reduced to 20

Mothership system's ship selection UI enlarged.

Fixed crashes with Linux systems

Fixed null crash caused by AP ammo selection against target with very low armor

Fixed issue with RGM/LGM from this mod having much better tracking than expected.

Fixed crash caused by RGM when the ship with it is destroyed and break into pieces.

Added 'Starting Colony' tag under nex for the Survivor's initial stations, ensuring they would not be invaded when the appropriate Nex option is added.

Fixed some missing translations from previous hotfix.

Implemented compatibility with Box Util 1.49 for those with issues.

[close]

Note: There is an Approlight Collab Side Quest that is not fully translated at this time

aiDescription: Adds a new faction called The Survivors, who emerge after a lost research fleet's AI disaster. Introduces a story-driven plot initiated by bar encounters, a roaming merchant fleet that improves with player relations, and a supply system requiring special commodities. Includes new ships, weapons like laser-guided missiles and armor-piercing autocannons, officer hiring via Lunalib, and nanoforge repair. Also adds a mother ship for on-the-go production and a hidden enemy plotline leading to station building and strategic resource control.
